symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis $i$, which counts the positions on that axis.
symbols.quote: Let $d$ be the number of axes and $s_i$ the length of axis $i$, with $s_1,\ldots,s_d$ pairwise coprime.

symbols.name: earlier length product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis $i$, which counts the positions on those axes.

symbols.name: inverse of P_i
symbols.meaning: The inverse of $P_i$ modulo $s_i$, an integer with $\mu_iP_i\equiv1\pmod{s_i}$.
symbols.quote: Since $P_i$ is coprime to $s_i$, it has an inverse $\mu_i$ modulo $s_i$, so $\mu_iP_i\equiv1\pmod{s_i}$.

symbols.name: axis variable
symbols.meaning: The variable of axis $i$ in the target ring.
symbols.quote: Let $x_i$ be the variable of axis $i$, and let $\Phi$ be the algebra map (a function respecting sums, products and complex scalars) with $\Phi(x)=\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, from $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ to $\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$.

symbols.name: axis map
symbols.meaning: The algebra map sending $x$ to $\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$.
symbols.quote: Let $x_i$ be the variable of axis $i$, and let $\Phi$ be the algebra map (a function respecting sums, products and complex scalars) with $\Phi(x)=\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$, from $\mathbb C[x]/(x^S-1)$ to $\mathbb C[x_1,\ldots,x_d]/(x_1^{s_1}-1,\ldots,x_d^{s_d}-1)$.

symbols.name: axis digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of the coefficient index $k$ on axis $j$, the coefficient of $P_j$ in its mixed-radix expansion.
symbols.quote: Its mixed-radix expansion $k=\sum_{j=1}^d a_jP_j$, with $0\le a_j<s_j$, is unique, and $a_j$ is the digit of $k$ on axis $j$.

symbols.name: target exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of $x_i$ in $\Phi(x^k)$, reduced to lie between $0$ and $s_i-1$.
symbols.quote: For $0\le k<S$, let $b_i$ be the exponent of $x_i$ in $\Phi(x^k)$, reduced so that $0\le b_i<s_i$; then $b_i\equiv\mu_ik\pmod{s_i}$.

relations.quote: Because $\Phi$ is an isomorphism, it preserves [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md): the product of two lists in the source maps to the product of their images.
